title: MalwareBazaar structural-hash searches (batch p3-G07-2: structural_hash_pivots)
notes: Manual counterparts of the P351 remote pivots: the MalwareBazaar browse search by imphash, TLSH, telfhash, gimphash and icon dHash. Search pages only (nothing submits, uploads or downloads samples). Shown when automation is skipped (e.g. MalwareBazaar 'license' terms under the corporate profile, A1). Not opened from this egress: abuse.ch browse pages put non-browser clients behind a browser check (research C0408), hence verified false and antibot true.
